title: Constructible support for arbitrary coefficient modules
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, Λ a commutative ring, and G a constructible sheaf of Λ-modules on X_et. The vanishing of the underlying abelian geometric stalk depends only on its point in X. Every point with zero stalk lies outside the support, and the support is constructible. The support is the set of points with nonzero geometric stalk. Constructible means a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which G is locally constant with finitely generated values [def-constructible-constructible].

proof.text:
zero stalks are independent of the chosen geometric point. On each constructible
stratum, choose the constant values of a trivializing etale cover. The support and its
complement are unions of the open images of the cover members with respectively nonzero
and zero value. Hence the support is clopen on each stratum. An embedded constructible
stratum is compact, and a clopen subset of it is constructible in the spectral base:
choose finitely many compact open basis members between that subset and an ambient open.
Take the finite union over the strata. Empty strata and the zero sheaf are included.
No finiteness of the coefficient ring is used.
